svg.title: Two clear legs do not imply a clear third leg

cc:Work.dc:title: Two clear legs do not imply a clear third leg
cc:Work.dc:description: Original abstract 2D point-plane illustration. L=(0,0), C=(2,0), F=(2,2). The only forbidden region is the closed rectangle [0.8,1.2] x [0.8,1.2]. L-C and C-F avoid it; L-F=(2t,2t) intersects it exactly for 2/5 <= t <= 3/5. Not a source figure, game geometry, navmesh execution, finite-body clearance, or an AI result.

cc:Agent.dc:title: Original geometric illustration rendered with Matplotlib
